extracted.intended_audience: editorial cartoonists and readers of cartooning/press-award news (e.g., members of the Association of American Editorial Cartoonists)
extracted.subtask_description: Information and implicit submission criteria for the Pulitzer category formerly called 'Editorial Cartooning', now renamed 'Illustrated Reporting and Commentary', including what kinds of work are eligible and the qualities the portfolio should demonstrate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category scope / accepted work types
rubrics_metrics.description: The Editorial Cartooning category is now called Illustrated Reporting and Commentary ... recognizes “a distinguished portfolio of editorial cartoons or other illustrated work (still, animated, or both) ...”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entrants may submit editorial cartoons or other illustrated work; the definition explicitly includes both still and animated illustrated work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Portfolio requirement (distinguished portfolio)
rubrics_metrics.description: recognizes “a distinguished portfolio of editorial cartoons or other illustrated work ...”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The prize is awarded for a portfolio (a body of work), not a single isolated cartoon; entries should be a cohesive, high-quality collection demonstrating distinction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Political insight
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed by the Pulitzer definition as one of the key characteristics the portfolio should demonstrate; the page does not further define the term.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial effectiveness
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Named as a separate evaluative quality by the Pulitzer definition; implies work should persuasively communicate editorial viewpoints or critique.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public service value
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included in the Pulitzer characterization, indicating work that serves or benefits the public interest may be especially valued.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission deadline / timing
rubrics_metrics.description: For Illustrated Reporters and Commentators who wish to enter the competition, be quick – January 25, 2022 is the deadline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical requirement: submit by the stated deadline (here: Jan 25, 2022) to be eligible; act promptly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category redefinition implication (broader eligibility)
rubrics_metrics.description: The category recognizes '... or other illustrated work.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The renaming and redefinition broaden eligibility beyond the traditional single-panel political newspaper cartoon, which may affect who chooses to enter and how work is framed for submission.
